Name: Spouse Helper-Realistic Married Life
Author: Changbaibai
Description:
[b][size=4]简介[/size][/b]
  Spouse Helper 是婚后内容的功能性Mod。安装后，玩家的配偶将主动参与农场日常劳动，并拥有完整的日程安排：清晨出门干活，傍晚返回农舍为玩家准备晚餐，夜深后上床休息。配偶还会在工作时发出对话气泡，主动呼叫玩家聊天，令农场生活更具真实感与沉浸感。并且可以跟随玩家，和玩家前往各区域约会。

[b][size=4]功能说明[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]1.农场劳作[/size][/b]
  每天清晨 6:10 起，配偶会自动进入农场并开始工作。支持以下七种任务类型：
[list]
[*]浇水[/*]
[*]收获作物[/*]
[*]捡拾地面物品（松露等）[/*]
[*]播种（需背包内有种子）[/*]
[*]施肥（需背包内有肥料）[/*]
[*]收取机器产物[/*]
[*]抚摸动物[/*]
[/list]  自动模式下，任务优先级依次为：浇水 > 收获 > 捡拾 > 收取机器 > 播种 > 施肥 > 抚摸动物。配偶会通过寻路系统逐一走到目标处执行操作，并在背包装满时停下来提示玩家。
[b]2.互动菜单[/b]
  当玩家位于配偶附近（距离 2 格以内）时，按下 P 键（可自定义）可打开互动菜单，包含以下选项：
[list]
[*]打开背包：查看并取走配偶收集到的物品，可放入物品。[/*]
[*]安排任务：手动指定配偶执行特定任务，或切换为自动模式。[/*]
[*]休息一下：让配偶停止工作，在农场中漫步。[/*]
[/list][i]注意：任务分配仅在下午 4:00 之前可用，超时配偶会拒绝并提示明日再做。[/i]
[b]3.配偶背包[/b]
  配偶拥有独立的背包（容量与普通箱子相同）。收获的作物、捡拾的物品均存放于此。玩家可随时通过菜单打开背包取走物品。若背包已满，配偶将停止活动。
[b]4.主动呼叫[/b]
  配偶会在工作时间（上午至下午 5:00 前）不定期主动呼叫玩家。每次呼叫会弹窗显示通知，配偶同时播放表情动作，并展示一条与当前时段相符的对话。默认每隔约 100 至 140 游戏分钟触发一次（可配置）。每次呼叫有 10% 的概率附带随机礼物。
[b]5.气泡对话[/b]
  配偶在工作时及傍晚在家闲逛时，会定期在头顶显示随机对话气泡。气泡内容会根据当前活动类别有所变化（浇水、收获、播种、抚摸动物、通用），默认每隔 15 至 40 秒触发一次（可配置）。
[b]6.晚间流程[/b]
  配偶的晚间行为按固定时间节点自动推进：
[list]
[*]下午 4:00：停止工作，经由农舍入口返回家中。[/*]
[*]下午 6:00（可关闭）：在厨房准备晚餐，并将食物交给玩家。若玩家不在同一地图，将在约3秒后自动完成交付。[/*]
[*]晚上 7:00：在农舍内随机漫步，并显示夜间气泡对话。[/*]
[*]晚上 10:00：上床休息。此后点击配偶只会触发睡眠表情，菜单不会打开。[/*]
[/list][b]7.雨天行为[/b]
  开启"雨天待在家"选项后，下雨时配偶不会外出干活，而是留在农舍内随机走动。若玩家通过菜单尝试安排户外任务，配偶会拒绝。下午 4:00 起正常进入晚间流程，晚餐照常提供。
[b]8.对话自定义[/b]
  所有对话均可通过编辑 JSON 文件自定义，文件位于 Mod 目录下的 assets/dialogues/ 文件夹。
[b]9.跟随及约会功能（新增）[/b]
  靠近配偶默认按P打开菜单，选择“跟我走”，配偶将进入跟随模式。
 跟随中按P键打开专属菜单：
[list]
[*][b]在此约会[/b] — 触发场景专属约会事件（ 目前海滩、山区、森林、小镇、沙漠、农场、农舍、姜岛可用 ）， 每天只能约会一次，有几率获得地点特别赠礼。[/*]
[*][b]停在这里[/b] — 配偶原地等待（下午5点未恢复会自动传送回家做晚饭）[/*]
[*][b]回家[/b] — 下午4点前传送回农场门口，4点后传送回厨房准备晚餐[/*]
[*][b]矿洞战斗[/b]：在矿洞/骷髅洞穴/火山地牢中，配偶会自动帮忙打怪，并且有专属战斗气泡对话，在矿洞地图中会禁用约会菜单。[/*]
[*][b]移速可调[/b]：config和GMCM中可自由调整跟随速度倍率[/*]
[/list][b]10.配偶心愿（新增）[/b]
  每周一配偶会请求玩家完成某项任务，完成后将给玩家稀有道具和金币作为奖励。并且累计完成一定次数后，将为玩家写一封感谢信并附送一枚功能强力的戒指。
[b]11.穿搭功能 （新增）[/b]
  每周三配偶将赠送玩家一整套服装，服装为固定搭配套装，数量多达30套。
[b]12.好感度系统 （新增）[/b]
  当配偶好感度低于特定值或连续给其他可婚NPC送礼时，配偶会拒绝工作。通过菜单要求干活会被反驳。好感度阈值和吃醋触发天数均可在设置中调整。

[b][size=4]安装说明[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI（版本要求 4.0.0 及以上）[/*]
[*]将 Mod 文件夹解压至 Stardew Valley/Mods/ 目录[/*]
[*]启动游戏，结婚后即可生效[/*]
[*]可选依赖：安装 Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM）可在游戏内调整所有配置项。[/*]
[/list]

[size=4]Introduction[/size]
Spouse Helper is a functional mod designed for post-marriage content. Once installed, the player's spouse will actively participate in daily farm work and follow a complete daily schedule: heading out to work in the morning, returning to the farmhouse in the evening to prepare dinner for the player, and going to bed late at night. The spouse will also display speech bubbles while working and proactively call out to the player for chats, making farm life feel more authentic and immersive.

[size=4]Features[/size]
[b]1. Farm Work[/b]
Every morning at 6:10 AM, the spouse will automatically enter the farm and begin working. The following seven task types are supported: 

[list]
[*]Watering [/*]
[*]Harvesting crops [/*]
[*]Foraging ground items (e.g., truffles) [/*]
[*]Planting seeds (requires seeds in inventory) [/*]
[*]Fertilizing (requires fertilizer in inventory) [/*]
[*]Collecting machine outputs [/*]
[*]Petting animals [/*]
[/list]
In automatic mode, task priorities are as follows: Watering > Harvesting > Foraging > Collecting machine outputs > Planting > Fertilizing > Petting. The spouse will navigate to each target using the pathfinding system and stop to notify the player when the backpack becomes full.

[b]2. Interaction Menu[/b]
When the player is within 2 tiles of the spouse, pressing the P key (configurable) opens the interaction menu, which includes the following options: 
[list]
[*]Open Backpack: View and take items collected by the spouse, or place items into it. [/*]
[*]Assign Task: Manually assign a specific task to the spouse, or switch back to automatic mode. [/*]
[*]Take a Break: Make the spouse stop working and wander around the farm. [/*]
[/list][i]Note: Task assignments are only available before 4:00 PM. After that time, the spouse will decline and suggest trying again tomorrow.[/i]

[b]3. Spouse Backpack[/b]
The spouse has an independent backpack with the same capacity as a standard chest. Harvested crops and foraged items are stored here. The player can open the backpack via the menu at any time to retrieve items. If the backpack becomes full, the spouse will stop working.
[b]
4. Proactive Calls[/b]
During work hours (from morning until 5:00 PM), the spouse will occasionally call out to the player. Each call triggers a pop-up notification, while the spouse performs an emote and displays a dialogue line appropriate to the current time of day. By default, this occurs approximately every 100–140 in-game minutes (configurable). Each call has a 10% chance of including a random gift.

[b]5. Speech Bubbles[/b]
While working or wandering around the farmhouse in the evening, the spouse will regularly display random dialogue bubbles above their head. The bubble content varies based on the current activity category (watering, harvesting, planting, petting, or general). By default, bubbles appear every 15–40 seconds (configurable).

[b]6. Evening Routine[/b]
The spouse's evening behavior progresses automatically according to a fixed schedule: 
[list]
[*]4:00 PM: Stops working and returns home via the farmhouse entrance. [/*]
[*]6:00 PM (toggleable): Prepares dinner in the kitchen and hands the meal to the player. If the player is not in the same map, delivery is automatically completed after approximately 3 seconds. [/*]
[*]7:00 PM: Wanders randomly inside the farmhouse and displays evening speech bubbles. [/*]
[*]10:00 PM: Goes to bed. After this time, clicking on the spouse only triggers a sleeping emote, and the menu will not open.[/*]
[/list]
[b]7. Rainy Day Behavior[/b]
With the "Stay home on rainy days" option enabled, the spouse will not go out to work during rain and will instead stay inside the farmhouse, wandering around randomly. If the player attempts to assign an outdoor task via the menu, the spouse will refuse. From 4:00 PM onward, the normal evening routine begins, and dinner is still provided as usual.

[b]8. Dialogue Customization[/b]
All dialogue can be customized by editing JSON files located in the `assets/dialogues/` folder within the mod directory.
[b]9. Follow & Date Feature (New)[/b]
  Approach your spouse and press P (default) to open the menu. Select "Follow me" and your spouse will enter follow mode.
  While following, press P to open an exclusive menu:
  - Date here — Triggers a location-specific date event (currently available at the beach, mountains, forest, town, desert, farm, farmhouse, and Ginger Island). You can only go on one date per day, with a chance to receive a special location-based gift.
  - Stay here — Your spouse waits in place (if not dismissed by 5 PM, they will automatically teleport home to cook dinner).
  - Go home — Before 4 PM, teleports to the farm entrance; after 4 PM, teleports to the kitchen to prepare dinner.
  - Mine combat: In the mines/Skull Cavern/Volcano Dungeon, your spouse will automatically help fight monsters with exclusive combat speech bubbles. The date menu is disabled on mine maps.
  - Adjustable movement speed: Follow speed multiplier can be freely adjusted in the config and GMCM.
10. Spouse Wishes (New)
  Every Monday, your spouse will ask you to complete a certain task. Upon completion, you will receive rare items and gold as rewards. After accumulating a certain number of completed wishes, your spouse will write you a thank-you letter along with a powerful functional ring.
11. Outfit Feature (New)
  Every Wednesday, your spouse will gift you a full set of clothing. The outfits are fixed coordinated sets, with up to 30 sets available.
12. Affection System (New)
  When your spouse's affection drops below a specific threshold or you give gifts to other marriageable NPCs for consecutive days, your spouse will refuse to work. Requesting chores through the menu will be met with a retort. The affection threshold and jealousy trigger duration are both adjustable in the settings.

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI (version 4.0.0 or higher required). [/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into the `Stardew Valley/Mods/` directory. [/*]
[*]Launch the game; the mod will take effect after marriage. [/*]
[*]Installing Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) allows you to adjust all configuration settings in-game.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Description: Your spouse helps with farm chores after marriage. Features affection system, follow mode, dating events, work summaries, customizable dialogue, auto-calling, dinner, and gift giving.
